headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: the AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles made its debut as Babes Of Wrath vs. Timeless Love Bombs battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.54. In the tournament final to crown the first-ever AEW Women's World Tag Team Champions, Babes of Wrath (Nightingale and Cameron) defeated Timeless Love Bombs (Storm and Shirakawa), with even the losing team joining the celebration afterward in a rare show of sportsmanship.

Looking back to 2021, when Rey Fenix reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing The Lucha Brothers vs. FTR, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.99 ? a solid showing in a physical tag team battle.

Looking back to 2025, when Samoa Joe vs. Eddie Kingston put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.56 ? a good, competitive contest. It marked Samoa Joe's 10th match with the title on the line. Samoa Joe defended his newly won AEW World Championship against Eddie Kingston.
